overview: A one-page Department of State list of papers concerning regulations governing aerial navigation in the Kwantung Leased Territory during 1931. It indexes three related records: comments by the American Minister in Tokyo on airplane flights over fortified zones; an accidental violation of a fortified zone by a British commercial aircraft of the Far East Aviation Company; and the appearance of American aircraft near a Japanese fortified zone outside Dairen, followed by a Japanese request for an expression of regret.

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on aerial navigation in Kwantung
subfiles.about: An index sheet identifies three 1931 records concerning foreign aircraft, fortified zones, and aerial-navigation regulations in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: The sheet cross-references despatch no. 103 from Japan containing Forbes's comments on requirements for flights over fortified zones in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It lists Dairen despatch no. 175 from Coville concerning an accidental incursion into a fortified zone by a British commercial aircraft belonging to the Far East Aviation Company and the local authorities' response. It also points to file 811.30-Asiatic Fleet/85 for a report from Chefoo by Franklin about American aircraft near a Japanese fortified zone outside Dairen and the Japanese government's wish that the American Consul at Dairen express regret.

interest: This sheet is useful as a compact roadmap to otherwise dispersed State Department records on the regulation of foreign aviation around Japan's fortified installations in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It documents two concrete aviation incidents involving British and American aircraft and shows how accidental overflights could prompt local enforcement and diplomatic demands. Its cross-references also connect the Japan internal-affairs decimal file to records concerning the U.S. Asiatic Fleet.
